verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Airbyte has a public API and CLI/Terraform tooling, but nothing documents API versioning conventions or a formal deprecation policy for those APIs; the only deprecation mention (a white-label product being sunset) is unrelated to API versioning practices. missing for 10: documented API version scheme (e.g., v1/v2 headers), a published deprecation/sunset policy, changelog or migration guides for breaking changes.
